title: AI detector evaluate_alert must run on MAX_AI_TASK_QUEUE and be registered there
answers: Why does an AI detector alert check error every cadence tick?
Which Temporal task queue does evaluate_alert run on for llm detector alerts?
How do I route a Temporal activity to the max-ai worker?
body:
Only the max-ai worker holds model provider credentials; the analytics-platform worker does not, so model calls there fail.
- Routing: `CheckAlertWorkflow.run` in posthog/temporal/alerts/workflows.py passes `task_queue=settings.MAX_AI_TASK_QUEUE` to `evaluate_alert` only when `prepare_result.uses_llm_detector`; otherwise `None` (workflow's own queue).
- The route is gated by `workflow.patched("alerts-evaluate-ai-detector-on-ai-queue")` so in-flight runs replay safely. Any new routing change on a live workflow needs a similar patch.
- Registration: activities routed to the AI queue must be listed in `AI_QUEUE_ACTIVITIES` (posthog/temporal/alerts/__init__.py) and appended to the MAX_AI_TASK_QUEUE entry in posthog/management/commands/start_temporal_worker.py. If not, the activity sits unpolled until timeout.
- Guard test: `test_ai_queue_registers_the_alert_evaluate_activity` in posthog/management/commands/test/test_start_temporal_worker.py.
applies: Temporal alert workflows and worker queue registration for the AI detector (`llm` detector type).
